description: This file contains test specifications for the 'evaluateHandle' method in a web automation context using Playwright. It tests the ability to handle JavaScript objects, primitives, nested structures, and argument passing.

methods.name: should work
methods.description: Tests basic usage of evaluateHandle to get a handle to the window object.

methods.name: should accept object handle as an argument
methods.description: Tests passing an object handle to evaluate and retrieving a property.

methods.name: should accept object handle to primitive types
methods.description: Checks if primitive values obtained from evaluateHandle can be used in further evaluation.

methods.name: should accept nested handle
methods.description: Tests passing a nested object handle into evaluate.

methods.name: should accept nested window handle
methods.description: Verifies passing the window handle into evaluate.

methods.name: should accept multiple nested handles
methods.description: Tests passing multiple object handles simultaneously.

methods.name: should accept same handle multiple times
methods.description: Checks repeated usage of the same handle in evaluate.

methods.name: should accept same nested object multiple times
methods.description: Tests passing the same object multiple times in arguments.

methods.name: should accept object handle to unserializable value
methods.description: Verifies handling of special primitive values like Infinity through handles.

methods.name: should pass configurable args
methods.description: Tests passing complex arguments and mutability within evaluate.

methods.name: should work with primitives
methods.description: Tests passing a handle that points to a primitive value.

ctags.name: foo
ctags.pattern: /^  const foo = await page.evaluateHandle(() => ({ x: 1, y: 'foo' }));$/

ctags.name: isFive
ctags.pattern: /^  const isFive = await page.evaluate(e => Object.is(e, 5), aHandle);$/

ctags.name: text
ctags.pattern: /^  const text = await page.evaluate(e => e.userAgent, navigatorHandle);$/
